### 2026-10-28: I started the cad for the case, I designed the front half of it, this part has a cutout for the screen to be seen through. I made sure to fillet all the edges so it looks nice and projessional. I down

**2h**

I started the cad for the case, I designed the front half of it, this part has a cutout for the screen to be seen through. I made sure to fillet all the edges so it looks nice and projessional. I downloaded a model of the screen to double check that it fits.

**2h**

I designed a back cover for the case of the display. this will hold everything together and will also allow a part to remove to be able to fix things if it becomes necessary. This back cover will replace the one that comes with the display.
